notes: The body-group fit tests (§1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3): a) absolute first line fits iff LINE-COUNTER is less than its integer, else page advance and, if the saved next group integer is set, LINE-COUNTER takes it and the test 'reapplies fit test rule 3a'; b) relative: LINE-COUNTER plus all LINE integers against the lower limit, and after an advance with a saved integer 'the content of LINE-COUNTER to the integer one and the integers of all but the first LINE NUMBER clause'; c) NEXT PAGE: advance when a body group is on the page, then the saved integer against the first absolute line. ReportWriter#PresentBody runs a)/b)/c) (skipping the chronologically first body group, which per 3b/3c has no body group on its page and per 3a always fits), #PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup is the saved-integer arm (the advance the 6a FOOTING setting always forces, then the reapplied 3a test or the 3b saved+1 trial and the second advance), #LowerLimit gives LAST DETAIL for CH/detail and FOOTING for CF, and #TerminateCore keeps the saved integer at 85 (DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup is 2023 only, kb/Work PB5245). Probes at 85 (PAGE 20 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 LAST DETAIL 15 FOOTING 18, page heading at 1) each matched the hand-derived 1985 layout: abs LINE 5 twice (p1 5-6, p2 5-6); NEXT GROUP 12 saved then abs LINE 5 (empty page 2, page 3 line 5) and abs LINE 14 (page 2 line 14); saved then relative (page 2 lines 13-14) and over the limit (empty page 2, page 3 from FIRST DETAIL); LINE 4 ON NEXT PAGE first (page 1 line 4, then page 2) and after saved 12 (page 3) and saved 3 (line 4 of the next page); TERMINATE's CF FINAL after a saved integer (page 2 line 13); relative fill to LAST DETAIL; CH bounded by LAST DETAIL and CF by FOOTING across a control break. The witness overflows a 3-line page on the fourth detail (PAGE-COUNTER 1 then 2).

next.reason: Fit tests kept: 2023 §2023:13.18.35.4 GR4 a) NEXT PAGE unsuccessful, b) 'If integer-1 is greater than LINE-COUNTER, the page fit is declared successful', c) relative trial sum against the lower limit; page advance per §2023:14.9.16.4 GR6; the saved-integer reapplication after the advance is §2023:13.18.37.4 GR4 a)1-3. Difference: 1985 applies the saved next group integer to whatever body group is presented next, including control footings TERMINATE presents; 2023 GR4 a) says the absolute NEXT GROUP 'will have no effect at all if a TERMINATE is next executed for the report'. Different placement for those control footings.
